meta.name: video-extend
meta.description: Extend / continue a video temporally with Pusa 2.2 in ComfyUI — temporal flowmatching (the flowmatch_pusa scheduler + WanVideoAddPusaNoise) on the WanVideoWrapper stack with WAN 2.2 T2V A14B (HIGH/LOW) models and the Pusa V1 LoRAs, conditioning on the loaded clip via WanVideoEncode so the existing motion carries into the continuation. Covers the kijai wanvideo_2_2_14B_Pusa_extension graph, model/LoRA slots + downloads, noise/length/scheduler settings, chaining multiple extensions, VRAM tiers, gotchas, and the extend→upscale handoff.
